description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 08.11.2021 to 14.11.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It sets new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves the establishment of a regulatory framework and compliance requirements for financial calculations related to customs, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). It does not involve government personnel changes, organisational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
